verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no Twilio documentation on how the Video media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether through managed autoscaling or regional media routing. Room settings such as TURN configuration and maximum participants are adjacent controls, not scaling documentation. The community comments about 4-way mesh limits reflect an early launch and do not describe any scaling architecture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
